title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Targeted response to essential needs of affected communities in Kachin State and Southeast Myanmar programme is implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: Individuals and communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief towards independence. The activities and objective include form and train women led peacebuilding groups, Strengthen capacity of CSO partners, conduct conflict mapping training and dialogue and design and implement social cohesion activities. So, communities in conflict affected areas have increased capacity for conflict resolution and promoting peaceful coexistence. Programmes are in partnership with Serve the World, KDG and EcoDev (ALARM). ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Establish new systems & structures through which groups, communities or people can lead the response through an active and influential role in shaping decisions that affect their lives- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Compensate for past discrimination
